definitions.wrong_operation: any emitted primitive differs from expected at same index, including extra primitive beyond expected sequence
definitions.numeric_step_error: primitive numerical result differs from applying emitted primitive to preceding reported state
definitions.format_extra_lines: at least one line outside allowed syntax
definitions.missing_or_multiple_answer: not exactly one strict Answer line

caution: Indicators overlap; do not sum as mutually exclusive causal shares. Prefix omission alone is not wrong_operation. Indices are zero-based.
